threat_event: The DSMS is unavailable or loses data beyond client commitments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warm standby region; RPO 1 hour, RTO 4 hours
treatment_plan: Twice-yearly DR tests; client status page

threat_event: AI-001 misses an anomaly at a client dam
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model piloted with 19 clients; clients may reduce manual review
regulatory_driver: Client contracts; C-DAMS-R02 (12.3(b)(4)(viii) for FERC-licensed clients)
treatment_plan: Client guidance that AI-001 does not replace manual review; quarterly back-tests (group plan GR-05)

threat_event: Alert thresholds or model versions change without review and silence real alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No formal change records for thresholds and models
treatment_plan: Formal change control with dam safety engineer approval for thresholds

threat_event: Client CEII in general engineering shares is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 project shares held inundation maps open to about 900 users
regulatory_driver: Client NDAs (18 CFR 388.113 terms passed through)
existing_controls: Project folders with access by team
treatment_plan: Move CEII to restricted project libraries; quarterly access review

threat_event: A tenant isolation defect shows one client's data to another
treatment_plan: Annual third-party penetration test of the DSMS

threat_event: An attacker in the DSMS uses the Hydro replication path toward OT
Clients do not renew because the DSMS has no SOC 2 report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 client contracts renewing in 2027 require a Type 2 report
existing_controls: Security questionnaires answered case by case
treatment_plan: SOC 2 Type 1 as of 2027-03-31, then Type 2 (P09)

threat_event: CUI from USACE A-E contracts is stored outside the FPE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineering staff use SYS-E2 for modeling
treatment_plan: Modeling compute for CUI inside the FPE; scans of SYS-E2 (group plan GR-06)

threat_event: Engineers paste client CEII into a generative AI drafting tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enterprise assistant approved for drafting; public tools blocked on managed devices only

threat_event: An AI-assisted analysis error reaches a sealed report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drafting assistant (AI-007) used for report text
treatment_plan: AI use disclosed in the quality checklist; no AI for calculations

threat_event: A compromised client gateway sends false data to the DSMS
treatment_plan: Alert clients on implausible data patterns

threat_event: An Engineering staff member works on a Part 12D inspection of a Hydro dam, breaking the independence rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Conflict checks exist; staffing done by project managers

threat_event: Drone and ROV imagery of client dams is held by an inspection app vendor without CEII terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor stores imagery in its cloud
treatment_plan: Add CEII handling terms at renewal

threat_event: An identity incident at cloud provider A stops the DSMS
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Engineering security and compliance lead: clients keep local alarms

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts engineering offices and the design environment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 offices; modeling compute in the cloud

threat_event: Loss of 2 key data scientists stalls AI-001 monitoring
